uncited: *   **Absorption Coefficient ($\sigma$):** A scalar value per voxel.
Value 1 means fully absorbing; 0 means no absorption.
*   **Update Buffer ($\sigma_{update}$):** A non-absorbing matrix (volume data) used to update the scene parameters.

*   **High GPU Memory Usage:** Auto-differential volume rendering requires significant GPU memory.
High resolutions or sample counts cause out-of-memory errors.
*   **Time Complexity:** The method is iterative and computationally expensive.
